g.text: Mains U2: two-layer thermal escape and TI stencil
Body-centred, top view, +Y down. Design geometry; native DRC and process acceptance pending.
Copper, tented vias and two-ended feeds
Y = ±1.90, ±2.70 mm. IN5 left; OUT6 right.
No new mask/paste openings; no vias in U2 pads.
Power-window gap 0.20 mm; no central GND pad.
